purpose: Single setup, then user just launches and walks away for 30 minutes

checklist.title: Mac one-time install (10 min)
actions: Drag to /Applications, allow in Privacy & Security if blocked
Run: python3 -m pip install --user pylsl pyxdf
Verify: python3 -c 'import pylsl, pyxdf; print(pylsl.__version__, pyxdf.__version__)'
Grant Local Network permission on first LabRecorder launch
checklist.expected_outcome: LabRecorder opens; pylsl import succeeds; smoke test stream visible in LabRecorder

checklist.title: ubu1 CLM W4 LSL server (5 min — once paste, then start each session)
actions: Verify on mac: python3 -c 'from pylsl import resolve_streams; [print(s.name(), s.type()) for s in resolve_streams(wait_time=5)]'
checklist.expected_outcome: Both CLM outlets visible from mac side

checklist.title: OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy 16ch electrode setup (10 min)
actions: Apply conductive paste/gel to scalp at 16-ch 10-20 montage (priority: P3, P4, O1, O2 alpha-rich)
Run impedance test; target < 30kOhm on >= 12/16 channels (mandatory < 10kOhm on P3/P4/O1/O2)
Enable Networking widget -> LSL -> stream name 'OpenBCI_Cyton16' or default 'obci_eeg1' -> Start LSL Stream
Append to state/anima_eeg_impedance_ledger.jsonl: pre-session impedance row
checklist.expected_outcome: EEG LSL stream live at 125Hz x 16ch; impedance logged

checklist.title: Open LabRecorder + start phase_runner.sh (1 min)
actions: In LabRecorder: click 'Update' -> all 4 streams (EEG, anima_clm_tension, anima_tension_link_5ch, anima_phase_marker) shown checked
Sit comfortably; follow voice prompts for next 30 minutes; do NOT touch keyboard during phases
checklist.expected_outcome: Phase runner emits SESSION_START marker; LabRecorder size increases

checklist.title: Post-session: stop, save, analyze (5 min auto)
actions: After SESSION_END voice prompt: in LabRecorder click 'Stop'
Append to state/anima_eeg_impedance_ledger.jsonl: post-session impedance row
Verdict prints to terminal + state/n_1_bridge_v2_realtime_prep_2026_05_02/realtime_verdict.json + per_phase_results.json written
checklist.expected_outcome: verdict.json contains F-PASS_STRONG / F-PASS_PARTIAL / F-FAIL / F-INDETERMINATE per Phase 6 falsifier

abort_conditions_user_should_recognize: If LabRecorder shows fewer than 4 streams after Update -> stop and re-verify each outlet (do NOT start the session)
If impedance > 30kOhm on >= 4 alpha-rich channels -> re-prep electrodes
If phase_runner.sh terminal exits before SESSION_END -> session is invalid, re-run from step 4
If ssh ubu1 connection drops mid-session -> CLM ledger truncated, but EEG continues; partial analysis still valid
